name: dsh-mutdiff-follow
displayName: DeepSeek Harness — follow the edited line
description: Follows the file and line DeepSeek Harness is editing, live, without stealing focus: the changed line is revealed and highlighted in place.

dshMutdiff.endpoint.description: The harness activity feed to follow. The plugin's route on the composed harness web server; the port must be the one `dsh web` listens on.

dshMutdiff.reveal.description: Reveal the edited line in place. The editor is opened without focus (`preserveFocus`), so this never brings the window to the front. Turn it off to keep only the status bar item.

dshMutdiff.highlightMs.description: How long the changed line stays highlighted, in milliseconds. `0` keeps the highlight until the next edit.

dshMutdiff.column.description: Which editor group the file is shown in. `active` keeps the layout untouched; `beside` splits off a follow column, which is often the calmest choice while working in another file.

commands.title: DSH follow: pause or resume following
DSH follow: open the last edited line (with focus)
DSH follow: reconnect to the harness
